subject: social
name: Social Studies
title: Grade 4 Social Studies: State History, Geography & Regional Economics
overview: Grade 4 Social Studies builds civic competence, geographical literacy, economic understanding, and historical inquiry aligned with the C3 Framework.
competencies: Investigate historical questions using multiple primary and secondary sources.
Analyze human and physical geography to understand how location and resources shape human decisions.
Explain economic concepts including production, market exchange, trade specialization, and public finance.
Apply democratic principles and civic virtues to deliberate contemporary public issues.

modules.title: State History: Native Peoples, Colonization & Statehood
modules.description: Exploring the indigenous inhabitants of the state, colonial settlements, key state historic figures, and state constitution.

topics.title: Indigenous Peoples of the Region
topics.description: Investigating tribal nations, regional geography, governance, and traditional agriculture.

topics.title: Colonial Encounters and Statehood History
topics.description: Tracing the state's founding treaties, pivotal conflicts, and transition to statehood.

modules.title: State Geography & Economic Industries
modules.description: Analyzing state geographic regions, major natural resources, agricultural centers, and technological industries.

topics.title: Physical Landscapes and Natural Resources
topics.description: Mapping river watersheds, mountain chains, coastal zones, and mineral deposits.

topics.title: State Economic Sectors & Trade Markets
topics.description: Investigating state agricultural output, manufacturing, tourism, and national trade networks.
